backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor defining data types and CRUD operations for user profiles, hospitals, blood donors, volunteers, SOS events, emergency alerts, and emergency contacts, with role-based access control via MixinAuthorization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades the actor state from OldActor (without emergencyContacts) to NewActor by adding an empty emergencyContacts map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (unauthenticated SOS call link, emergency contacts management, authenticated SOS with contacts) to their source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and key functionality.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the CrisisConnect app, loading Leaflet CSS/JS from CDN and mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router route tree with all app routes (dashboard, hospitals, blood donors, volunteers, map, emergency contacts) nested under AppLayout, plus a standalone login route.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertCrea: Collapsible form component for posting emergency alerts with type, description, and location fields, submitting to the backend via the usePostEmergencyAlert hook.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertFeed: Displays a feed of emergency alerts (fire, flood, accident, etc.) with color-coded styling, time-ago formatting, and loading skeletons using data from the useEmergencyAlerts hook.
frontend/src/components/auth/UserProfile: Modal form for new users to set up their profile (name, city, contact) by calling the saveCallerUserProfile mutation, shown as an overlay before accessing the app.
Card component displaying a blood donor's name, blood type (color-coded), city, and contact phone link.
frontend/src/components/chatbot/ChatbotB: Floating action button that toggles the FirstAidChatbot panel open or closed, with a red gradient style and a badge indicator.
frontend/src/components/chatbot/FirstAid: Chat UI for a first-aid decision-tree bot, rendering message bubbles with markdown bold support, step-by-step guidance cards, warnings, and emergency category buttons.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/StatCa: Reusable stat card component that displays an icon, numeric value, and label with color-themed styling (red/amber/blue/green) and a loading skeleton state.
frontend/src/components/hospitals/Hospit: Card component showing a hospital's name, address, available beds (color-coded by availability), contact link, and optional distance from the user.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application shell providing a sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, SOS button, user profile setup modal trigger, chatbot button, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/sos/SOSButton.ts: Renders a pulsing red SOS button that opens the SOSModal when clicked.
frontend/src/components/sos/SOSModal.tsx: Modal that handles the full SOS flow: geolocation, 5-second countdown, sending the SOS record to the backend, and displaying emergency contact info after submission.
frontend/src/components/volunteer/Volunt: Displays a volunteer's name, city, active status, and color-coded skill tags in a card layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirstAidBot.ts: Manages chat state for a first-aid assistant bot, handling user messages, keyword-based guidance lookup, category selection, and conversation reset.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Provides a requestLocation function that wraps the browser Geolocation API and returns the resolved position, loading state, and any error.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login, logout, identity, and login status to the component tree.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, hospitals, blood donors, volunteers, emergency alerts, SOS events, and emergency contacts.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind, imports Inter and Space Grotesk fonts, defines a dark emergency theme via CSS custom properties, and adds custom utilities/animations (glow effects, SOS pulse, Leaflet dark theme overrides, scrollbar styling).
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/BloodDonorPage.tsx: Page for browsing and registering blood donors, featuring a filterable/searchable donor list and a registration form that submits to the backend via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying real-time stats (hospitals, beds, donors, volunteers) in stat cards alongside a live emergency alert feed and an alert creation form with quick-access navigation links.
frontend/src/pages/EmergencyContactsPage: Authenticated page for managing personal emergency contacts, allowing users to add (with validation) and remove contacts that are displayed during SOS alerts.
frontend/src/pages/HospitalFinderPage.ts: Page for finding nearby hospitals with search and availability filters, using geolocation to calculate and sort hospitals by haversine distance from the user.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the CrisisConnect login page with a hero banner, feature highlights, and an Internet Identity login button, redirecting authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/ResourceMapPage.tsx: Displays an interactive Leaflet map showing hospitals and blood donor locations with distance calculations, a sidebar listing hospitals sorted by proximity, and geolocation support.
frontend/src/pages/VolunteerPage.tsx: Provides a volunteer management page where users can register as emergency volunteers and browse/filter existing volunteers by name, city, skill, and active status.
Defines a decision-tree data structure mapping emergency categories (CPR, choking, bleeding, etc.) to step-by-step first aid guidance, urgency levels, and warnings.
frontend/src/utils/haversine.ts: Exports a haversine formula function to calculate the great-circle distance in kilometers between two lat/lng coordinates, plus a helper to format the distance as meters or kilometers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the CrisisConnect frontend, extending the default theme with custom emergency-palette colors (crisis-red, amber, blue, green, dark), OKLCH CSS variable-based semantic color tokens, custom fonts (Inter, Space Grotesk), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 7) for CrisisConnect, documenting the app summary, tech stack (React/Tailwind, Node.js/Firebase, Google Maps, OpenAI), architectural notes, known issues (map page hospital tracking), and a registry of existing implemented features with their requirement IDs and versions.
